campaign.name: HashNHedge Compute Launch Campaign
campaign.clientNeed: Acquire miners and compute providers to bootstrap the decentralized compute marketplace at launch
campaign.objective: Onboard 500 active mining nodes in first 90 days across XMR, RVN, ETC, ERG, and KAS pools
campaign.audience: Crypto miners, PC gamers with idle GPUs, datacenter operators, AI researchers, passive-income seekers
campaign.offer: First month at 0% platform fee + exclusive early-adopter NFT badge
campaign.successDefinition: 500 active nodes with 10 TH/s combined hashrate and <2% churn per month
researchObjectives: Identify solo miners and small mining ops dissatisfied with pool fee structures and opaque reward systems
Map PC gaming communities with high-end GPU ownership who could offset hardware costs through idle mining
Surface AI researchers and ML engineers actively seeking affordable decentralized compute alternatives to AWS/GCP
Collect evidence on competitor fee structures and payout models to position HashNHedge's advantage
designGuidelines: Dark cyberpunk base with cyan and purple accent glow for hashrate visualization
Live hashrate meters and earnings tickers as hero visual elements
Coin-specific color coding (XMR=orange, RVN=blue, ETC=green, ERG=red, KAS=purple)
Transparent fee disclosure visually prominent on every pricing card
Mobile-first card layout for dashboard density on miner phone screens
contentAngles: Your GPU earns more idle than most altcoins will in a year
Transparent pool payouts with zero hidden deductions — every share counted
From gaming rig to mining node: offset your hardware cost in 90 days
Decentralized compute isn't the future — it's running on your desktop right now
Multi-coin auto-switching means your hashpower always chases peak profitability
